title: Enterprise docs: Optimize config history + safe rollback, RBAC, and audit logs
author: Elliot Price
description: Adds first-pass customer-facing documentation for the Safe apply + rollback mechanism for Optimize configuration changes. Scope: (1) what “config versions” are, what metadata is stored, and how to view history/compare; (2) how enterprise admins and operators execute a one-click rollback and what “whole-config rollback” means (including documented exceptions and runtime behaviors); (3) RBAC permissions required to view/apply/rollback configs; (4) audit log semantics, event names, and SIEM/export guidance; (5) deployment-mode notes for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private. Includes screenshot stubs/placeholders for Console flows (history timeline, compare modal, rollback confirmation, progress view, audit log detail page) and adds cross-links to API reference and incident runbook concepts without exposing internal tooling. Follow-ups are called out inline with TODO tags for final screenshots once Console UI copy and audit event names are finalized in the control plane implementation.
commits: docs(enterprise): add Optimize config history and rollback overview
docs(security): document RBAC permissions for apply/rollback + suggested roles
docs(audit): add audit log taxonomy + example payload fields
docs(console): add screenshot stubs + UI field glossary
chore: add redirects and nav entries for new pages
review_conversation: Marissa Cole: In the rollback section, can we explicitly say “whole-config rollback” and clarify that we don’t support partial field-by-field rollback in v1? Also please align UI labels with the Console copy (we use “Rollback to version” not “Revert”).

Elliot Price (author): Updated wording to “whole-config rollback” and added a callout box explaining the v1 constraint + what we mean by “documented exceptions” (e.g., ephemeral runtime cache state). Also updated UI strings to match Console draft copy and added a TODO tag to re-check after ENG-4826 lands.

Fiona McCarthy: Please be careful not to over-promise audit log retention. Add a note that retention is tenant-configurable and that some fields may be redacted depending on policy. Also include explicit permission names for apply/rollback.

Elliot Price (author): Added a retention section: defaults by tier are described as “typical defaults” and point to contract/addendum for authoritative values. Added redaction note (PII/prompt content not logged by default) and listed permissions as optimize.config.apply + optimize.config.rollback + optimize.config.read.

Rafael Mendes: In the operational guidance, recommend a short validation checklist post-rollback (latency/error dashboards, rollout status, and sample requests). Also mention that rollback is idempotent and safe to retry if the UI shows partial progress.

Elliot Price (author): Added a “Post-rollback validation (5 minutes)” checklist and a note on safe retry behavior + correlation IDs for support escalation. Kept it customer-facing (no internal dashboard names), but referenced the relevant metric categories and where to find them in Console.

Dylan Brooks: The screenshot stubs are fine, but please ensure alt text is meaningful for accessibility and that we don’t block on screenshots for merge. Also link to API docs for list versions / rollback endpoints.
Elliot Price (author): Added descriptive alt text for all placeholder images and included an API reference section with endpoint names + a minimal curl example (sanitized).
Svetlana Petrenko: Add a small section on exporting audit logs to SIEM and include the fields customers should correlate on (request_id, actor, scope, version_id).
Elliot Price (author): Added SIEM/export section + correlation fields and a short example of filtering for rollback events.
